_comment: A DELIBERATELY BROKEN condition file, for the recording (docs/recording-script.md, 0:30).
One character wrong: "within_meters" for "within_m". Under the capture format's own
unknown-key rule (s13, ignore it) this would parse as a proximity condition with no
threshold - and a threshold that silently did not apply is twenty confident passes.
A condition file inverts that rule deliberately, because a person writes it. M5 measured
the cost of getting this wrong on a campaign file (F-23) and M6 applied the lesson here
before it could be paid twice.
